info.name: Gadget Revibe API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Gadget Revibe - Repair Services Web Application

## Overview
This API supports a multi-tenant repair services marketplace with Customer, Vendor, and Admin roles.

## Authentication
- Uses Laravel Sanctum for token-based authentication
- After login, include the token in Authorization header as: `Bearer {token}`

## Base URL
`{{base_url}}/api`

## Default Credentials
- Admin: admin@gadgetrevibe.com / Admin@123456
- Customer: customer@gadgetrevibe.com / Customer@123456
- Vendor: vendor@gadgetrevibe.com / Vendor@123456
